## Figure legend

**Supplementary Figure 8. Expression of *NRG1*, *STP4* and *NDT80* over the time course in rich and minimal medium.**
DESeq2-normalized counts (+1, log~10~ scale) of the transcription factor genes *NRG1*, *STP4* and *NDT80*
(knocked out in Figure 6) in wild-type SC5314 grown in rich (YPD) or carbon-limited minimal medium. Points
are biological replicates; lines join the mean of the log-scaled values at each time point. Time is on a
log~2~ scale. The shaded area marks the quiescent phase (`r params$late_time`–72 h). Triangles are the
additional rich 72 h libraries from a second sequencing run (HJT3JDRX7), which have low mRNA depth. The
temporal cluster of each gene (Supplementary Figure 9, Figure 4B) is given under its name.

## Input data

The inputs in `data/` are outputs of
`CandidaTFKO5_WT_72h/analysis/WT_Rich_vs_Minimal_timecourse_DESeq2_ORA.Rmd`
(`new_72h_mode = "add"`, `n_clusters = 8`). This figure is the "Genes of interest" plot of that analysis,
restyled and restricted to the three transcription factors knocked out in Figure 6.

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `normalized_counts.csv.gz` | DESeq2 size-factor-normalized counts, 46 libraries (WT, rich and minimal, 2–72 h) |
| `timecourse_gene_clusters.csv` | Temporal cluster and LRT results of the time-responsive genes |

```{r load}
nc <- fread(data_path("normalized_counts.csv.gz"), data.table = FALSE)
nmat <- as.matrix(nc[, -1]); rownames(nmat) <- nc[[1]]
clusters <- fread(data_path("timecourse_gene_clusters.csv"))

# Sample annotation, parsed from the library names as in the analysis.
# CandidaTFKO5_WT_72h-* are the Rich 72 h libraries from run HJT3JDRX7.
new_run <- grepl("^CandidaTFKO5_WT_72h", colnames(nmat))
samples <- data.table(
  sample = colnames(nmat),
  medium = ifelse(grepl("^WT_C_", colnames(nmat)), "Minimal", "Rich"),
  time = ifelse(new_run, 72L, as.integer(sub("^WT_[YC]_(\\d+)-\\d$", "\\1", colnames(nmat)))),
  batch = ifelse(new_run, "HJT3JDRX7", "prior"))
times <- sort(unique(samples$time))
samples[, .N, by = .(medium, time)][order(medium, time)]
```

```{r genes}
goi <- params$genes
stopifnot(all(goi %in% rownames(nmat)))
gene_info <- clusters[match(goi, gene), .(gene, cluster, time_Rich, time_Minimal, medium_x_time,
                                          padj_medium_x_time = signif(padj_medium_x_time, 2))]
gene_info[, gene := goi]  # keep genes without a temporal cluster (cluster NA)
gene_info

expr <- melt(data.table(gene = goi, nmat[goi, , drop = FALSE]), id.vars = "gene",
             variable.name = "sample", value.name = "count", variable.factor = FALSE)
expr <- merge(expr, samples, by = "sample")
expr <- merge(expr, gene_info[, .(gene, cluster, medium_x_time)], by = "gene")
fwrite(expr[order(match(gene, goi), medium, time, sample)], out_path("Supplementary_Figure_08_counts.csv"))
```

## Figure

```{r plot}
medium_cols <- c(Rich = "#D9934E", Minimal = "#8C6BB1")  # Figure 4 hues; Minimal darkened for lines
strip_label <- function(g) {
  i <- match(g, gene_info$gene)
  sprintf("*%s*<br><span style='font-size:9pt;color:#555555'>%s</span>", g,
          ifelse(is.na(gene_info$cluster[i]), "not clustered", paste("cluster", gene_info$cluster[i])))
}

goi_row <- function(genes) {
  d <- expr[gene %in% genes]
  d[, `:=`(facet = factor(strip_label(gene), levels = strip_label(genes)),
           medium = factor(medium, levels = names(medium_cols)))]
  ggplot(d, aes(time, count + 1, colour = medium)) +
    # shade from midway (log scale) between the last proliferative and the first quiescent time point;
    # ymin = 0 becomes -Inf on the log10 axis
    annotate("rect", xmin = sqrt(params$late_time * max(times[times < params$late_time])), xmax = Inf,
             ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey92") +
    stat_summary(aes(group = medium), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = batch), size = 1.7, alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.12)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = medium_cols, name = "Medium") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(prior = 16, HJT3JDRX7 = 2), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2", breaks = times) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    facet_wrap(~ facet, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Normalized count + 1") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_markdown(size = 12, lineheight = 1.1),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.5),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(4, "mm"), legend.position = "bottom")
}

# single panel, no panel letter
fig <- goi_row(goi)
fig

ggsave(out_path("Supplementary_Figure_08.pdf"), fig, width = params$fig_width, height = params$fig_height,
       device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(out_path("Supplementary_Figure_08.png"), fig, width = params$fig_width, height = params$fig_height,
       dpi = 300)
```
